meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行计划,由多个智能体分工推进并持续记录进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果已经排好一份计划,想交给 AI 智能体按步骤执行并保持进度同步
copy.tagline_en: Run your plan with parallel agents and keep progress tracked.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a ready plan and want AI agents to execute it while keeping progress tracked.

howto.what: 装上后,当你要执行工作计划时,Claude 会将计划拆成小任务,派给多个子代理并行执行,自己只做进度跟踪、状态更新和结果验收,不会亲自写代码或改文件。
howto.when: 当你说“开始工作”、“执行计划”、“继续计划”等,或要求运行 .omo/plans 目录下的某个计划时触发。

say.text: 开始执行 .omo/plans 里的计划
say.note: 它会把计划拆成子任务并行执行。
它会接着未完成的检查项继续派活。

say.text: 用 --make-pr 执行计划并开 PR
say.note: 它会创建工作分支并最终提交 PR。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude becomes an orchestrator: it breaks the plan into small tasks, assigns them to parallel subagents, and only tracks progress, state, and verdicts — it never writes code or edits files itself.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'start work', 'execute plan', 'continue plan', etc., or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans.

say_en.note: It decomposes the plan and runs subagents in parallel.
It resumes the next unchecked task and dispatches it.

say_en.text: Run the plan with --make-pr and open a PR
say_en.note: It creates a worktree and delivers the work as a PR.
